sampling_unit: Langfuse trace = one user turn (hw4.md: one trace per user turn). Labels and scores attach to turn-level trace ids. Each drawn trace brings its conversation's other turns into the same batch as context-carrying session_sibling picks; batch sizes are stated as drawn conversations, which match the handout.
harness_affected_policy: Option A: traces containing a harness exception (for example 'database is locked') stay in the sample and are flagged. The exception itself is not a failure mode; the agent's handling of it is reviewed.

pre_review.description: Part A review in the standard Langfuse view; not counted in any batch

counting.note: Report both units: distinct traces (turns) and distinct conversations (cartwheel.session_id). The 100-minimum is met under both.
counting.sampling_caveat: Batches 1-3 draw uniformly over turns, so conversations with more turns were slightly more likely to be drawn. Batch 4 draws uniformly over conversations.

part_d_searches.definition_at_run: Fail when the reply says the order or item the user named is not in the caller's records, while a tool result in the conversation contains it (e.g. by product id).
part_d_searches.signal: user names a product title; a tool result holds that product id (tier 1) or not (tier 2); the final reply denies finding it

part_d_searches.definition_at_run: Fail when the reply says the order or item the user named is not in the caller's records, while a tool result in the conversation contains it (e.g. by product id).
part_d_searches.signal: user names a product (partial title match); a tool result holds that product id (tier 1) or not (tier 2); the final reply denies finding it
part_d_searches.command: uv run python -m analysis.review_app.search_mode --run v2 --match partial

part_d_searches.definition_at_run: Fail when the reply says the order or item the user named is not in the caller's records, while a tool result in the conversation contains it (e.g. by product id).
part_d_searches.signal: user names a product (any title match); a tool result holds that product id (tier 1) or not (tier 2); the final reply denies finding it
part_d_searches.command: uv run python -m analysis.review_app.search_mode --run B --match any

part_d_searches.definition_at_run: Fail when the reply says an order the user named (by product, store or order id) is not among the caller's orders, while an order-lookup result in the conversation (list_my_orders, get_order, find_order) contains it.
part_d_searches.signal: user names a product (partial title match); an order-lookup result (list_my_orders, get_order, find_order) holds that product id; the final reply denies finding it
part_d_searches.command: uv run python -m analysis.review_app.search_mode --run C --match partial --scope orders

part_d_searches.signal: final reply asks which order / for an order id or clarification, OR the user gave no order id with a refund/return/delivery request and list_my_orders returned more than one order
